bio.text: Steven Tanner represents Idaho House District 13, Seat B, according to the Idaho Legislature's 2026 membership directory, which lists Nampa as the legislator's city.

The directory biography says Tanner was born in Honolulu and raised in a military family, and holds a B.A. in philosophy from California State University, Long Beach, and an M.Div. from Fuller Seminary.
It also lists an M.A. in clinical mental health counseling from Liberty University and says Tanner is a licensed professional counselor in Idaho.
